title: NgsInterpretationResponse
description: Top-level response payload describing the parsed and interpreted output of a single NGS report. Consolidates the audit envelope, specimen context, normalized variants and biomarkers, FDA companion-diagnostic flags, ClinicalTrials.gov match candidates, and contraindications into a vendor-agnostic structure. Maps cleanly to a FHIR Bundle whose root is a Genomics-IG DiagnosticReport when downstream consumers want a FHIR view, but is intentionally simpler than a literal FHIR Bundle for engineering ergonomics.

variants.description: All genomic variants reported. May be empty for a normal/negative report.

biomarkers.description: All non-variant biomarkers measured in this report (TMB, MSI, PD-L1, ER/PR/HER2, etc.). May be empty when the source assay does not cover any biomarker classes.

cdxFlags.description: Companion-diagnostic matches for this case. Empty when no variant or biomarker matches an approved CDx label indication for this tumor type.

trialMatches.description: Clinical-trial match candidates. The pipeline returns matches; final eligibility is a clinician decision.

contraindications.description: Negative therapy implications: drugs to avoid or de-escalate based on findings in this report.

recommendations.description: Engine 2 (CDS) recommendations augmenting this parsed report. Optional — present when Engine 2 has been run against this NgsInterpretationResponse. Output is REFERENCE MATERIAL — explicitly NOT clinical advice. Every recommendation traces to an evidence chain and carries a Non-Device CDS attestation.
